## Geocoding

::: {.fragment}

- Geocoding - Converting an address to longitude / latitude coordinates.

  - Sample providers:
    - [ESRI ArcGIS](https://developers.arcgis.com/rest/geocode/geocode-addresses/)
      - Score measures the quality of the geocoding
    - [Google Maps](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geocoding/reference/rest/v4beta/GeocodeResult.Granularity)
    - [mapbox](https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/geocoding/)
  - Quality matters...
:::

::: {.notes}
Knowing where the location is is extremely important. I'll focus mainly on geocoding today.

There are lots of vendors that provide Geocoding. Don't try to roll your own. It's hard to get it right and maintain it.

I've listed a few of the larger non-insurance-specific geospatial vendors on the slide. 

If you have a particularly new address and some slick software engineers, you could pull the EXIF metadata from photos taken by the customer, agent, underwriter, etc. to get the location.

:::
